script:
# Server Script — "Chatwoot Message Templates"
# Script Type: API | API Method: chatwoot_message_templates | Allow Guest: No
#
# The customer WhatsApp texts sent when a Chatwoot ticket moves to another status (Kanban column).
#   action=get   (any agent)                -> default template + one row per status
#   action=save  (Agent Manager / System Manager), payload {default_template?, rows: [{status, enabled, message}]}
#   action=pause (Agent Manager / System Manager), payload {paused: 1|0} -> stops / allows every automatic WhatsApp
#                (customers and agents; private notes still go). Each change leaves a Chatwoot Sync Log row.
#   action=team_numbers (Agent Manager / System Manager), payload {tech_phone, sales_phone} -> saves the Sales-alert team
#                numbers (Chatwoot Settings sales_alert_tech_phone / sales_alert_sales_phone; normalized/validated by the
#                Before Save Server Script "Chatwoot Settings Team Numbers"). The numbers are returned to managers only.
# Rows live in Chatwoot Settings.status_messages; a status without a row (or with an empty message) uses the
# default template; a row with enabled=0 means "send nothing for this status".

PLACEHOLDERS = ["{name}", "{ticket}", "{subject}", "{status}"]

user = frappe.session.user
roles = frappe.get_all("Has Role", filters={"parent": user, "parenttype": "User",
	"role": ["in", ["System Manager", "Agent Manager", "Agent"]]}, pluck="role")
is_admin = user == "Administrator" or "System Manager" in roles
can_edit = is_admin or "Agent Manager" in roles
if not (can_edit or "Agent" in roles):
	frappe.throw("Not permitted", frappe.PermissionError)

args = frappe.form_dict
action = args.get("action") or "get"
payload = args.get("payload") or {}
if isinstance(payload, str):
	payload = json.loads(payload) if payload.strip() else {}

s = frappe.get_doc("Chatwoot Settings")

if action == "save":
	if not can_edit:
		frappe.throw("Only Agent Managers can change customer messages.", frappe.PermissionError)
	if "default_template" in payload:
		text = str(payload.get("default_template") or "").strip()
		if not text:
			frappe.throw("The default message cannot be empty.")
		s.customer_message_template = text[:1000]
	valid = frappe.get_all("HD Ticket Status", pluck="name")
	for r in payload.get("rows") or []:
		status = str(r.get("status") or "")
		if status not in valid:
			frappe.throw("Unknown status: " + status)
		row = None
		for x in s.status_messages or []:
			if x.status == status:
				row = x
		if row is None:
			row = s.append("status_messages", {"status": status})
		row.enabled = 1 if r.get("enabled") else 0
		row.message = str(r.get("message") or "").strip()[:1000]
	s.save(ignore_permissions=True)
	s = frappe.get_doc("Chatwoot Settings")

if action == "pause":
	if not can_edit:
		frappe.throw("Only Agent Managers can pause or resume WhatsApp messages.", frappe.PermissionError)
	paused = 1 if payload.get("paused") else 0
	if (1 if s.whatsapp_paused else 0) != paused:
		s.whatsapp_paused = paused
		s.save(ignore_permissions=True)
		frappe.get_doc({"doctype": "Chatwoot Sync Log", "direction": "Outbound", "status": "Success",
			"event": "whatsapp_paused" if paused else "whatsapp_resumed",
			"error": ("Paused" if paused else "Resumed") + " by " + frappe.get_fullname(user)}).insert(ignore_permissions=True)
	s = frappe.get_doc("Chatwoot Settings")

if action == "team_numbers":
	if not can_edit:
		frappe.throw("Only Agent Managers can change the team numbers.  /  Maamulayaasha keliya ayaa beddeli kara numbarrada kooxaha.", frappe.PermissionError)
	old_numbers = [s.get("sales_alert_tech_phone") or "", s.get("sales_alert_sales_phone") or ""]
	s.sales_alert_tech_phone = str(payload.get("tech_phone") or "").strip()
	s.sales_alert_sales_phone = str(payload.get("sales_phone") or "").strip()
	s.save(ignore_permissions=True)
	s = frappe.get_doc("Chatwoot Settings")
	new_numbers = [s.get("sales_alert_tech_phone") or "", s.get("sales_alert_sales_phone") or ""]
	frappe.get_doc({"doctype": "Chatwoot Sync Log", "direction": "Outbound", "status": "Success", "event": "team_numbers",
		"error": ("Team numbers saved (no change)" if old_numbers == new_numbers else "Team numbers changed") + " by " + frappe.get_fullname(user)}).insert(ignore_permissions=True)

rows = []
for x in s.status_messages or []:
	rows.append({"status": x.status, "enabled": 1 if x.enabled else 0, "message": x.message or ""})
frappe.flags.templates = {
	"default_template": s.customer_message_template or "",
	"send_customer_messages": 1 if s.send_customer_messages else 0,
	"whatsapp_paused": 1 if s.whatsapp_paused else 0,
	"enabled": 1 if s.enabled else 0,
	"can_edit": 1 if can_edit else 0,
	"placeholders": PLACEHOLDERS,
	"rows": rows,
}
if can_edit:
	frappe.flags.templates["team_numbers"] = {"tech_phone": s.get("sales_alert_tech_phone") or "", "sales_phone": s.get("sales_alert_sales_phone") or ""}

name: Chatwoot Poll
script:
# Server Script — "Chatwoot Poll"
# Script Type: Scheduler Event | Event Frequency: Cron | Cron Format: */10 * * * *
#
# Safety net for missed webhooks: every 10 minutes, list open Chatwoot conversations with the ticket label
# (through the door) and, for each one without a ticket, run the webhook's own ticket logic in poll mode:
#   run_script("Chatwoot Webhook", conversation_id=..., source="poll")
# One Inbound Chatwoot Sync Log row per run (event "poll", counts). Does nothing while the integration is off,
# except masking secrets in Error Log (see below).

MAX_PER_RUN = 20  # new tickets attempted per run; the rest wait for the next run

s = frappe.get_doc("Chatwoot Settings")

# Error Log hygiene (runs even while disabled): frappe.make_*_request logs failures with local variables, which
# can contain the API token or our keys. Mask them in Error Log rows of the last 30 days (modify, never delete).
secrets = []
for f in ["api_token", "webhook_key", "internal_key"]:
	v = s.get_password(f, raise_exception=False)
	if v and len(v) >= 16:
		secrets.append(v)
since = frappe.utils.add_to_date(frappe.utils.now_datetime(), days=-30)
scrubbed = 0
for sec in secrets:
	rows = frappe.db.sql("select name, method, error from `tabError Log` where creation > %(t)s and "
		"(error like %(p)s or method like %(p)s)", {"t": since, "p": "%" + sec + "%"}, as_dict=True)
	for row in rows:
		err = row.error or ""
		meth = row.method or ""
		for other in secrets:
			err = err.replace(other, "***")
			meth = meth.replace(other, "***")
		frappe.db.set_value("Error Log", row.name, {"error": err, "method": meth}, update_modified=False)
		scrubbed = scrubbed + 1

if s.enabled:
	started = frappe.utils.now_datetime()
	found = 0
	existing = 0
	created = 0
	skipped = 0
	failed = 0
	errors = []
	ok = True
	lst = (run_script("Chatwoot API", action="list_labeled_conversations", payload={}) or {}).get("chatwoot_result") or {}
	if not lst.get("ok"):
		ok = False
		errors.append("list_labeled_conversations failed (HTTP " + str(lst.get("status")) + "), see " + str(lst.get("log")))
	ids = lst.get("ids") or []
	found = len(ids)
	tried = 0
	for cid in ids:
		if frappe.db.exists("HD Ticket", {"chatwoot_conversation_id": str(cid)}) or frappe.db.exists("HD Ticket", {
				"chatwoot_reply_conversation": str(cid), "status": ["not in", ["Resolved", "Closed", "Cancelled"]]}):
			existing = existing + 1
			continue
		if tried >= MAX_PER_RUN:
			break
		tried = tried + 1
		try:
			res = (run_script("Chatwoot Webhook", conversation_id=cid, source="poll") or {}).get("chatwoot_webhook") or {}
			if res.get("ticket"):
				created = created + 1
			elif res.get("status") == "Failed":
				failed = failed + 1
				errors.append("#" + str(cid) + ": " + str(res.get("note"))[:200])
			else:
				skipped = skipped + 1
		except Exception as e:
			failed = failed + 1
			errors.append("#" + str(cid) + ": " + str(e)[:200])
	counts = {"found": found, "existing": existing, "created": created, "skipped": skipped, "failed": failed,
		"error_logs_masked": scrubbed}
	frappe.get_doc({
		"doctype": "Chatwoot Sync Log",
		"direction": "Inbound",
		"event": "poll",
		"status": "Failed" if (not ok or failed) else "Success",
		"duration_ms": int((frappe.utils.now_datetime() - started).total_seconds() * 1000),
		"response": json.dumps(counts),
		"error": "\n".join(errors)[:2000] or None,
	}).insert(ignore_permissions=True)

# Server Script — "Chatwoot Webhook Old URL"
# Script Type: API | API Method: chatwoot_webhook | Allow Guest: Yes
#
# Decoy on the old, keyless URL /api/method/chatwoot_webhook. The real webhook lives at
# /api/method/chatwoot_webhook_<key> (Server Script "Chatwoot Webhook"). This only records the attempt as a
# Rejected Inbound Sync Log row (no body, no query, no cmd) and returns. Never calls Chatwoot.
# Logging is rate limited: at most one Rejected Inbound row per minute (shared with the real webhook).

since = frappe.utils.add_to_date(frappe.utils.now_datetime(), seconds=-60)
if not frappe.db.exists("Chatwoot Sync Log", {"direction": "Inbound", "status": "Rejected", "creation": [">", since]}):
	frappe.get_doc({
		"doctype": "Chatwoot Sync Log",
		"direction": "Inbound",
		"event": str(frappe.form_dict.get("event") or "unknown")[:140],
		"status": "Rejected",
		"method": "POST",
		"path": "/api/method/chatwoot_webhook",
		"error": "old/keyless URL",
	}).insert(ignore_permissions=True)
frappe.flags.chatwoot_webhook = {"ok": False, "rejected": True}

script:
# Server Script — "Engineer Monthly Report Validate"
# Script Type: DocType Event | Reference Doctype: Engineer Monthly Report | Event: Before Save (validate)
#
# 1. Ownership: non-managers can only create/edit their own report (engineer = session user).
#    New reports are owned by the engineer, so the Agent "if owner" permission works even when a
#    manager generated the report.
# 2. Status flow (field status, no Workflow, no emails): Draft -> Submitted (engineer or manager),
#    Submitted -> Approved (manager, Head Comment required), Submitted -> Draft (manager).
#    Non-managers cannot change a report once it is Submitted/Approved.
# 3. Suggested challenge rows the engineer deleted are remembered in dismissed_suggestions (JSON list of
#    ticket names) so a refresh does not add them again.
# 4. When doc.flags.yool_refresh is set (API yool_engineer_report_generate / _refresh), the ticket data is
#    re-pulled: activities and summary numbers are replaced; challenges, feedback and head_comment typed
#    by people are never removed, only new rows are added.
# safe_exec: no imports, no tuple unpacking, no "d[k] += x", no _-prefixed attributes, no def helpers that
# need script-level names (so everything is inline).

user = frappe.session.user
is_manager = user == "Administrator" or bool(frappe.db.sql(
    "SELECT 1 FROM `tabHas Role` WHERE parenttype = 'User' AND parent = %(u)s"
    " AND role IN ('Agent Manager', 'System Manager') LIMIT 1",
    {"u": user},
))

if not doc.engineer:
    frappe.throw("Please select the Engineer.", title="Engineer required")
if not frappe.db.exists("HD Agent", doc.engineer):
    frappe.throw("The Engineer must be a Helpdesk agent.", title="Not an agent")
if not is_manager and doc.engineer != user:
    frappe.throw("You can only create or edit your own Engineer Monthly Report.", title="Not permitted")

doc.engineer_name = (
    frappe.db.get_value("HD Agent", doc.engineer, "agent_name")
    or frappe.db.get_value("User", doc.engineer, "full_name")
    or doc.engineer
)
if not doc.period_type:
    doc.period_type = "Month"
if not doc.from_date or not doc.to_date:
    frappe.throw("Please set From Date and To Date.", title="Period required")
from_date = frappe.utils.getdate(doc.from_date)
to_date = frappe.utils.getdate(doc.to_date)
if from_date > to_date:
    frappe.throw("From Date cannot be after To Date.", title="Invalid period")
doc.report_date = to_date

duplicate = frappe.db.sql(
    "SELECT name FROM `tabEngineer Monthly Report` WHERE engineer = %(e)s AND from_date = %(f)s"
    " AND to_date = %(t)s AND name != %(n)s LIMIT 1",
    {"e": doc.engineer, "f": from_date, "t": to_date, "n": doc.name or ""},
)
if duplicate:
    frappe.throw(
        "A report for this engineer and period already exists: " + duplicate[0][0] + ".",
        title="Duplicate report",
    )

# The engineer owns the report (Agent permission is "if owner"), also when a manager made or moved it.
doc.owner = doc.engineer
old = None
if not doc.is_new():
    old = doc.get_doc_before_save()

# ---------- status flow ----------
old_status = (old.status if old else "Draft") or "Draft"
new_status = doc.status or "Draft"
doc.status = new_status
if doc.is_new() and new_status != "Draft" and not is_manager:
    frappe.throw("A new report must start as Draft.", title="Not permitted")
if old and old_status != new_status:
    allowed = False
    if old_status == "Draft" and new_status == "Submitted":
        allowed = True
    elif old_status == "Submitted" and new_status == "Approved" and is_manager:
        allowed = True
    elif old_status == "Submitted" and new_status == "Draft" and is_manager:
        allowed = True
    if not allowed:
        frappe.throw(
            "Status cannot change from " + old_status + " to " + new_status + " for you.",
            title="Not permitted",
        )
    if new_status == "Approved" and not (doc.head_comment or "").strip():
        frappe.throw("Please write the Head Comment before approving this report.", title="Head Comment required")
elif old and not is_manager and old_status != "Draft":
    frappe.throw(
        "This report is " + old_status + ". Only an Agent Manager can change it now.",
        title="Not permitted",
    )

# ---------- head comment: managers only ----------
if not is_manager:
    old_comment = (old.head_comment if old else None) or ""
    if (doc.head_comment or "") != old_comment:
        frappe.throw("Only an Agent Manager can write the Head Comment.", title="Not permitted")

# ---------- remember deleted suggestions ----------
dismissed = []
try:
    dismissed = json.loads(doc.dismissed_suggestions or "[]") or []
except Exception:
    dismissed = []
present = [c.source_ticket for c in (doc.challenges or []) if c.source_ticket]
if old:
    for c in (old.challenges or []):
        if c.suggested and c.source_ticket and c.source_ticket not in present and c.source_ticket not in dismissed:
            dismissed.append(c.source_ticket)

# ---------- re-pull ticket data (only when the API asks for it) ----------
if doc.flags.yool_refresh:
    eng = doc.engineer
    escaped = eng.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("%", "\\%").replace("_", "\\_")
    rows = frappe.db.sql(
        "SELECT t.name, t.subject, t.status, COALESCE(s.category, t.status_category) AS category,"
        " t.customer, COALESCE(cu.customer_name, t.erp_customer_name) AS client,"
        " t.opening_date, t.agreement_status, t.solved_by, t.time_spent, t.resolution_details,"
        " t.feedback, t.feedback_rating, t.feedback_extra, t._assign AS assign_json"
        " FROM `tabHD Ticket` t"
        " LEFT JOIN `tabHD Ticket Status` s ON s.name = t.status"
        " LEFT JOIN `tabCustomer` cu ON cu.name = t.customer"
        " WHERE t.opening_date BETWEEN %(f)s AND %(t)s AND t._assign LIKE %(pat)s"
        " ORDER BY t.opening_date ASC, t.creation ASC",
        {"f": from_date, "t": to_date, "pat": '%"' + escaped + '"%'},
        as_dict=True,
    )
    # Same rule as the Agent Ticket Report: the exact user must be in the _assign JSON.
    tickets = []
    for r in rows:
        users = []
        try:
            users = json.loads(r.assign_json or "[]") or []
        except Exception:
            users = []
        if eng in users:
            tickets.append(r)
    names = [r.name for r in tickets]

    # Visit cost = Bajaaj expense (GL 5225, posted only by Expense Bill), same source as the Agent Ticket
    # Report. Bills with hd_ticket go to that ticket; otherwise a bill of this agent (Employee.user_id) is
    # matched to the agent's ticket of the same customer opened on the bill's date, each bill to one ticket.
    cost = {}
    e_values = {"account": "5225 - Bajaaj Expense - YT", "f": from_date, "t": to_date}
    ticket_cond = ""
    if names:
        ticket_cond = " OR eb.hd_ticket IN %(names)s"
        e_values["names"] = tuple(names)
    expenses = frappe.db.sql(
        "SELECT gle.voucher_no, SUM(gle.debit - gle.credit) AS amount,"
        " COALESCE(eb.customer, IF(gle.party_type = 'Customer', gle.party, NULL)) AS expense_customer,"
        " eb.hd_ticket, emp.user_id AS agent_user, eb.expense_date, MIN(gle.posting_date) AS posting_date"
        " FROM `tabGL Entry` gle"
        " LEFT JOIN `tabExpense Bill` eb ON gle.voucher_type = 'Expense Bill' AND eb.name = gle.voucher_no"
        " LEFT JOIN `tabEmployee` emp ON emp.name = eb.employee"
        " WHERE gle.account = %(account)s AND gle.is_cancelled = 0"
        " AND (gle.posting_date BETWEEN %(f)s AND %(t)s" + ticket_cond + ")"
        " GROUP BY gle.voucher_type, gle.voucher_no, expense_customer, eb.hd_ticket, emp.user_id, eb.expense_date"
        " ORDER BY MIN(gle.posting_date), gle.voucher_no",
        e_values,
        as_dict=True,
    )
    for e in expenses:
        amount = frappe.utils.flt(e.amount, 2)
        if not amount:
            continue
        if e.hd_ticket:
            if e.hd_ticket in names:
                cost[e.hd_ticket] = cost.get(e.hd_ticket, 0) + amount
            continue
        if e.agent_user != eng or not e.expense_customer:
            continue
        bill_day = str(e.expense_date or e.posting_date)
        candidates = [x.name for x in tickets if x.customer == e.expense_customer and str(x.opening_date) == bill_day]
        if not candidates:
            continue
        free = [c for c in candidates if not cost.get(c)]
        target = free[0] if free else candidates[0]
        cost[target] = cost.get(target, 0) + amount

    # Activity rows are updated in place by ticket (same row names), so the version history only shows
    # real changes; rows for tickets no longer in the period are dropped, new tickets are added.
    existing_rows = {}
    for a in (doc.activities or []):
        if a.ticket and a.ticket not in existing_rows:
            existing_rows[a.ticket] = a
    new_rows = []
    resolved = 0
    missing_time = 0
    total_cost = 0
    visited = []
    customers = []
    ranked = []  # [-minutes, position, ticket] for the "3 longest" suggestions (no lambdas/key needed)
    for r in tickets:
        visit_cost = frappe.utils.flt(cost.get(r.name, 0), 2)
        solved_by = r.solved_by or ("Visit" if visit_cost > 0 else "Office")
        # time_spent is Data "h:mm" (normalized by Server Script "HD Ticket Time Spent").
        minutes = 0
        ts_parts = str(r.time_spent or "").strip().split(":")
        if len(ts_parts) == 2 and ts_parts[0].isdigit() and ts_parts[1].isdigit():
            minutes = int(ts_parts[0]) * 60 + int(ts_parts[1])
        if minutes > 0:
            mm = str(minutes % 60)
            if len(mm) < 2:
                mm = "0" + mm
            time_text = str(int(minutes // 60)) + ":" + mm
            ranked.append([-minutes, len(ranked), r])
        else:
            time_text = "—"
            missing_time = missing_time + 1
        done = r.category == "Resolved" or r.status in ("Resolved", "Closed")
        if done:
            resolved = resolved + 1
        if r.customer and r.customer not in customers:
            customers.append(r.customer)
        if solved_by == "Visit" and r.customer and r.customer not in visited:
            visited.append(r.customer)
        total_cost = total_cost + visit_cost
        values = {
            "ticket": r.name,
            "activity_date": r.opening_date,
            "client_name": (r.client or "").strip(),
            "issue": r.subject,
            "solved_by": solved_by,
            "time_spent_text": time_text,
            "activity_status": "Done" if done else "Pending",
            "visit_cost": visit_cost,
        }
        row = existing_rows.get(r.name)
        if row:
            row.update(values)
            new_rows.append(row)
        else:
            new_rows.append(values)

    doc.set("activities", new_rows)
    position = 0
    for a in doc.activities:
        position = position + 1
        a.idx = position

    new_clients = 0
    if customers:
        firsts = frappe.db.sql(
            "SELECT customer, MIN(opening_date) AS first_date FROM `tabHD Ticket`"
            " WHERE customer IN %(c)s GROUP BY customer",
            {"c": tuple(customers)},
            as_dict=True,
        )
        for x in firsts:
            if x.first_date and from_date <= frappe.utils.getdate(x.first_date) <= to_date:
                new_clients = new_clients + 1

    doc.works_done = len(tickets)
    doc.issues_resolved = resolved
    doc.new_clients = new_clients
    doc.clients_visited = len(visited)
    doc.missing_time_count = missing_time
    doc.total_visit_cost = frappe.utils.flt(total_cost, 2)
    doc.last_refreshed = frappe.utils.now_datetime()

    # Suggested challenges: every SLA-failed ticket, then the 3 longest time_spent tickets.
    suggestions = [r for r in tickets if r.agreement_status == "Failed"]
    for item in sorted(ranked, key=lambda x: [x[0], x[1]])[:3]:
        if item[2] not in suggestions:
            suggestions.append(item[2])
    present = [c.source_ticket for c in (doc.challenges or []) if c.source_ticket]
    for r in suggestions:
        if r.name in present or r.name in dismissed:
            continue
        solution = ""
        if r.resolution_details:
            try:
                solution = frappe.utils.strip_html(r.resolution_details) or ""
            except Exception:
                solution = r.resolution_details or ""
            solution = " ".join(solution.replace(" ", " ").split())
            if len(solution) > 500:
                solution = solution[:497] + "..."
        doc.append("challenges", {
            "challenge": (r.subject or "").strip() + " (" + ((r.client or "").strip() or "-") + ", ticket " + r.name + ")",
            "solution": solution,
            "suggested": 1,
            "source_ticket": r.name,
        })
        present.append(r.name)

    # Feedback: stored ticket feedback not yet in the table; 2 empty rows if there is none at all.
    fb_present = [f.ticket for f in (doc.feedback or []) if f.ticket]
    for r in tickets:
        if r.name in fb_present:
            continue
        if not (r.feedback_rating or (r.feedback_extra or "").strip() or r.feedback):
            continue
        text = (r.feedback_extra or "").strip()
        if r.feedback:
            text = (r.feedback + (": " + text if text else ""))
        doc.append("feedback", {
            "client_name": (r.client or "").strip(),
            "feedback": text,
            "rating": r.feedback_rating or 0,
            "ticket": r.name,
        })
        fb_present.append(r.name)
    if not (doc.feedback or []):
        doc.append("feedback", {})
        doc.append("feedback", {})

# ---------- file name base ----------
months = ["January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June", "July", "August",
          "September", "October", "November", "December"]
if doc.period_type == "Month":
    period_text = months[from_date.month - 1] + "_" + str(from_date.year)
else:
    period_text = frappe.utils.formatdate(from_date, "dd-MM-yyyy") + "_" + frappe.utils.formatdate(to_date, "dd-MM-yyyy")
doc.file_base = ((doc.engineer_name or doc.engineer) + "_work_report_" + period_text).replace(" ", "_")

doc.dismissed_suggestions = json.dumps(dismissed) if dismissed else None

name: HD Ticket Caller Validation
script:
# Server Script — "HD Ticket Caller Validation"
# Script Type: DocType Event | Reference Doctype: HD Ticket | Event: Before Save
#
# 1. Company: erp_customer (Company / Shirkadda) and the standard customer field are
#    kept in sync; erp_customer_name and primary_contact_name (Primary Contact /
#    Macmiilka) always come from the Customer record.
#    Portal (Website) users can only ever get their own linked Customer; whatever
#    they send is ignored, and they cannot change it on existing tickets.
# 2. New tickets created by an agent must have caller_name and caller_phone
#    (email / customer-portal / system-created tickets are not blocked).
# 3. caller_phone: Somali formats are normalized to +252XXXXXXXXX; any other full
#    international number (+country code, 8-15 digits) is kept as +<digits>.
#    Anything else is rejected.
# Old tickets are not touched unless someone edits these fields.

user = frappe.session.user
is_agent_user = user not in ("Administrator", "Guest") and frappe.db.get_value("HD Agent", user, "is_active") == 1
is_portal_user = (
    user not in ("Administrator", "Guest")
    and not is_agent_user
    and frappe.db.get_value("User", user, "user_type") == "Website User"
)

if is_portal_user:
    if doc.is_new():
        # Only the Customer linked to the portal user's own Contact (exactly one), else none.
        own_customer = None
        contact = frappe.db.get_value("Contact", {"user": user}, "name") or frappe.db.get_value(
            "Contact", {"email_id": user}, "name"
        )
        if contact:
            links = frappe.db.sql(
                "SELECT DISTINCT link_name FROM `tabDynamic Link`"
                " WHERE parenttype = 'Contact' AND parentfield = 'links'"
                " AND link_doctype = 'Customer' AND parent = %(contact)s",
                {"contact": contact},
            )
            if len(links) == 1:
                own_customer = links[0][0]
        doc.erp_customer = own_customer
        doc.customer = own_customer
        if not (doc.caller_name or "").strip():
            doc.caller_name = frappe.db.get_value("User", user, "full_name")
    elif doc.has_value_changed("erp_customer") or doc.has_value_changed("customer"):
        frappe.throw("Company cannot be changed.  /  Shirkadda lama beddeli karo.", title="Not permitted")
elif doc.is_new():
    # The Company field on the agent form wins; tickets from email/desk keep their customer.
    if doc.erp_customer:
        doc.customer = doc.erp_customer
    elif doc.customer:
        doc.erp_customer = doc.customer
elif doc.has_value_changed("erp_customer"):
    doc.customer = doc.erp_customer
elif doc.has_value_changed("customer"):
    doc.erp_customer = doc.customer

doc.erp_customer_name = frappe.db.get_value("Customer", doc.erp_customer, "customer_name") if doc.erp_customer else None
if doc.is_new() or doc.has_value_changed("erp_customer"):
    primary = frappe.db.get_value("Customer", doc.erp_customer, "customer_primary_contact") if doc.erp_customer else None
    doc.primary_contact_name = (frappe.db.get_value("Contact", primary, "full_name") or None) if primary else None

caller_name = (doc.caller_name or "").strip()
raw_phone = (doc.caller_phone or "").strip()
doc.caller_name = caller_name or None
doc.caller_role = (doc.caller_role or "").strip() or None

if doc.is_new() and is_agent_user and (not caller_name or not raw_phone):
    frappe.throw(
        "Fadlan geli magaca iyo lambarka qofka la soo xiriiray (Caller Name iyo Caller Phone).  /  "
        "Please enter the Caller Name and Caller Phone.",
        title="Caller details required",
    )

if raw_phone:
    # Only spaces, dashes, dots and brackets are dropped; anything else stays and fails the check.
    cleaned = "".join([c for c in raw_phone if c not in " -.()"])
    if cleaned.startswith("+"):
        digits = cleaned[1:]
    elif cleaned.startswith("00"):
        digits = cleaned[2:]
    else:
        digits = cleaned

    # Local part = the 9 digits after the 252 country code.
    if digits.startswith("252") and len(digits) == 12:
        local = digits[3:]
    elif digits.startswith("0") and len(digits) == 10:
        local = digits[1:]
    elif len(digits) == 9:
        local = digits
    else:
        local = ""

    if digits.isdigit() and len(local) == 9 and local.isdigit() and local[0] != "0":
        # Somali number -> always stored as +252XXXXXXXXX.
        doc.caller_phone = "+252" + local
    elif (cleaned.startswith("+") or cleaned.startswith("00")) and digits.isdigit() and 8 <= len(digits) <= 15 and digits[0] != "0":
        # Any other country's full international (E.164) number -> stored as +<digits>.
        doc.caller_phone = "+" + digits
    else:
        frappe.throw(
            "Geli number buuxa oo caalami ah (+ country code), ama number Soomaali ah (06.../+252...). "
            "Tusaale: 06XXXXXXXX, +2526XXXXXXXX ama +44XXXXXXXXXX.  /  "
            "Enter a full international number (+country code) or a Somali number. "
            "Example: 06XXXXXXXX, +2526XXXXXXXX or +44XXXXXXXXXX.",
            title="Invalid Caller Phone",
        )
else:
    doc.caller_phone = None

name: HD Ticket Chatwoot Link
script:
# Server Script — "HD Ticket Chatwoot Link"
# Script Type: DocType Event | Reference Doctype: HD Ticket | Event: After Insert
#
# Every NEW ticket made in Helpdesk is linked to the caller's WhatsApp conversation (Chatwoot default inbox):
#   phone = caller_phone, else the Contact's mobile, else the Customer's mobile (same last-9-digits rule)
#   - open conversation exists  -> link it + private note with the ticket link (no WhatsApp message)
#   - no open conversation      -> create one + ONE welcome WhatsApp (Chatwoot Settings "Welcome message"),
#                                  only when customer messages are on (test numbers / rate limit / JOOJI in the door)
# Tickets created FROM Chatwoot (label "ticket") are already linked and skipped. Old tickets are not touched.
# The link is kept in chatwoot_reply_conversation (one customer may have several tickets; chatwoot_conversation_id
# stays unique for label-created tickets). A Chatwoot problem never blocks creating the ticket.

# Everything (settings, passwords, int(), run_script) is inside try: nothing here may block the ticket save.
try:
	if not doc.chatwoot_conversation_id and doc.source != "Chatwoot":
		s = frappe.get_cached_doc("Chatwoot Settings")
		if s.enabled:
			phone = doc.caller_phone
			if not phone and doc.contact:
				phone = frappe.db.get_value("Contact", doc.contact, "mobile_no") or frappe.db.get_value("Contact", doc.contact, "phone")
			if not phone and (doc.erp_customer or doc.customer):
				phone = frappe.db.get_value("Customer", doc.erp_customer or doc.customer, "mobile_no")
			raw_p = str(phone or "").strip()
			digits = "".join([c for c in raw_p if c.isdigit()]).lstrip("0")
			if digits.startswith("252") and len(digits) == 12:
				digits = digits[3:]
			# Somali = 9 local digits; anything else must be a full international number (+ / 00 / 11+ digits,
			# 8-15 digits total — user-approved 2026-10-19: intl customers get the welcome message too),
			# passed with a leading + so intl() in the Chatwoot API door accepts it.
			is_intl = len(digits) != 9 and (raw_p.startswith("+") or raw_p.startswith("00") or len(digits) >= 11) and 8 <= len(digits) <= 15
			send_phone = ("+" + digits) if is_intl else digits
			if len(digits) != 9 and not is_intl:
				frappe.get_doc({"doctype": "Chatwoot Sync Log", "direction": "Outbound", "event": "link_ticket", "status": "Skipped",
					"reference_ticket": doc.name, "error": "No valid phone on the ticket, contact or customer"}).insert(ignore_permissions=True)
			else:
				ikey = s.get_password("internal_key", raise_exception=False)
				company = frappe.db.get_value("Customer", doc.erp_customer or doc.customer, "customer_name") if (doc.erp_customer or doc.customer) else None
				try:
					got = (run_script("Chatwoot API", action="ensure_conversation", internal_key=ikey, payload={"phone": send_phone, "ticket": doc.name,
						"name": doc.caller_name or company or (send_phone if is_intl else "+252" + digits), "company": company}) or {}).get("chatwoot_result") or {}
					conv = got.get("conversation_id")
					if conv:
						frappe.db.set_value("HD Ticket", doc.name, {"chatwoot_reply_conversation": str(conv),
							"chatwoot_contact_id": str(got.get("contact_id") or "")}, update_modified=False)
						link = (s.helpdesk_url or "https://portal.yool.tech").rstrip("/") + "/helpdesk/tickets/" + str(doc.name)
						run_script("Chatwoot API", action="add_private_note", internal_key=ikey, payload={"conversation_id": conv, "ticket": doc.name,
							"content": "🎫 Ticket #" + str(doc.name) + " created in Helpdesk: " + link})
						if got.get("new_conversation") and s.welcome_message_template:
							text = s.welcome_message_template.replace("{caller_name}", str(doc.caller_name or company or "")).replace(
								"{id}", str(doc.name)).replace("{subject}", str(doc.subject or ""))
							sent = (run_script("Chatwoot API", action="send_customer_message", internal_key=ikey, payload={"conversation_id": conv,
								"ticket": doc.name, "phone": send_phone, "kind": "welcome", "content": text}) or {}).get("chatwoot_result") or {}
							if sent.get("ok"):
								frappe.db.set_value("HD Ticket", doc.name, "chatwoot_welcome_sent", 1, update_modified=False)
				except Exception as e:
					frappe.log_error("Chatwoot link: ticket " + str(doc.name), str(e))
except Exception as e:
	frappe.log_error("Chatwoot link: ticket " + str(doc.name), str(e)[:1000])

name: HD Ticket Chatwoot Sync
script:
# Server Script -- "HD Ticket Chatwoot Sync"
# Script Type: DocType Event | Reference Doctype: HD Ticket | Event: After Save
#
# Helpdesk -> Chatwoot on every status change (every Kanban column a ticket moves to):
#   0. NO linked conversation yet (customer never wrote on WhatsApp, or the insert-time link was skipped/failed):
#      resolve the customer's phone (caller_phone -> Contact mobile/phone -> Customer mobile), then
#      "ensure_conversation" in the Chatwoot API door finds-or-creates the Chatwoot contact (name from
#      caller_name, else the Customer, else the number) and a WhatsApp conversation in the default inbox, and the
#      ids are stored in chatwoot_reply_conversation / chatwoot_contact_id. Creating a contact or conversation
#      sends NOTHING by itself. The WhatsApp inbox is Channel::Api (unofficial gateway via wa-app.sadarsms.com,
#      source_id 252...@s.whatsapp.net), so free-form text reaches brand-new contacts too: no Meta Cloud API
#      24h window and no approved-template requirement. Auto-create only runs when customer messages are on,
#      WhatsApp is not paused and the ticket has not opted out; no valid phone or a failed create writes one
#      plain-text Chatwoot Sync Log row (event auto_link_status, status Skipped/Failed).
#   1. ONE customer-facing message (normal/public, message_type outgoing, private false -- goes out on WhatsApp)
#      in professional Somali announcing the new status, signed "— Yooltech Support" (real em dash in the live string). No internal links.
#      User decision 2026-10-19: this REPLACES both the old private note ("Ticket #... -> Status by Agent" + portal
#      link) and the old per-status template message (Chatwoot Settings.status_messages / customer_message_template
#      are no longer read here). JOOJI opt-out, "Send customer-facing messages", WhatsApp pause, Test numbers and
#      the rate limit are all still enforced inside "Chatwoot API".
#   2. Resolved/Closed: label "ticket-resolved" on the conversation
# "Sales" (2026-10-22) is an internal intake lane (Kanban column SALES, Server Script "HD Ticket Source Team"):
# a change INTO Sales sends nothing to the customer; moving OUT of it (Assigned / In Progress ...) sends as usual.
# Everything goes through the outbound door (Chatwoot API) and is logged in Chatwoot Sync Log there.
# A Chatwoot problem never blocks saving the ticket.

# Everything (settings, passwords, int(), run_script) is inside try: nothing here may block the ticket save.
try:
	if doc.has_value_changed("status") and not doc.flags.in_insert and doc.status != "Sales":
		s = frappe.get_cached_doc("Chatwoot Settings")
		if s.enabled:
			ikey = s.get_password("internal_key", raise_exception=False)
			conv = doc.chatwoot_conversation_id or doc.chatwoot_reply_conversation
			# The customer's phone: caller_phone, else the Contact's, else the Customer's (same rule as the link script).
			phone = doc.caller_phone
			if not phone and doc.contact:
				phone = frappe.db.get_value("Contact", doc.contact, "mobile_no") or frappe.db.get_value("Contact", doc.contact, "phone")
			if not phone and (doc.erp_customer or doc.customer):
				phone = frappe.db.get_value("Customer", doc.erp_customer or doc.customer, "mobile_no")
			raw_p = str(phone or "").strip()
			digits = "".join([c for c in raw_p if c.isdigit()]).lstrip("0")
			if digits.startswith("252") and len(digits) == 12:
				digits = digits[3:]
			# Somali = 9 local digits; anything else must be a full international number (+ / 00 / 11+ digits),
			# passed with a leading + so intl() in the Chatwoot API door accepts it.
			is_intl = len(digits) != 9 and (raw_p.startswith("+") or raw_p.startswith("00") or len(digits) >= 11) and 8 <= len(digits) <= 15
			send_phone = ("+" + digits) if is_intl else digits
			if not conv and s.send_customer_messages and not s.whatsapp_paused and not doc.chatwoot_opted_out:
				# 0. Auto-link so the status message below has somewhere to go. Delivery itself is still gated in
				#    the door (Test numbers, JOOJI, rate limit); this step only creates/finds contact + conversation.
				if len(digits) != 9 and not is_intl:
					frappe.get_doc({"doctype": "Chatwoot Sync Log", "direction": "Outbound", "event": "auto_link_status",
						"status": "Skipped", "reference_ticket": doc.name,
						"error": "Status message not sent: no valid phone on the ticket, contact or customer"}).insert(ignore_permissions=True)
				else:
					company = frappe.db.get_value("Customer", doc.erp_customer or doc.customer, "customer_name") if (doc.erp_customer or doc.customer) else None
					got = (run_script("Chatwoot API", action="ensure_conversation", internal_key=ikey,
						payload={"phone": send_phone, "ticket": doc.name,
							"name": doc.caller_name or company or (send_phone if is_intl else "+252" + digits),
							"company": company}) or {}).get("chatwoot_result") or {}
					if got.get("conversation_id"):
						conv = got.get("conversation_id")
						frappe.db.set_value("HD Ticket", doc.name, {"chatwoot_reply_conversation": str(conv),
							"chatwoot_contact_id": str(got.get("contact_id") or "")}, update_modified=False)
					else:
						frappe.get_doc({"doctype": "Chatwoot Sync Log", "direction": "Outbound", "event": "auto_link_status",
							"status": "Failed", "reference_ticket": doc.name,
							"error": "Could not find or create the WhatsApp conversation (see the ensure_conversation rows above)"}).insert(ignore_permissions=True)
			if conv:
				conv = int(conv)
				category = frappe.db.get_value("HD Ticket Status", doc.status, "category") or ""
				# One line, plain text: collapse any whitespace/newlines in the subject.
				subject = " ".join(str(doc.subject or "").split())
				somali = {
					"Assigned": "Codsigaaga #{id} ({subject}) waxaa loo xilsaaray injineerkeena, waana lagu soo socodsiin doonaa.",
					"In Progress": "Codsigaaga #{id} ({subject}) hadda waa laga shaqaynayaa.",
					"Paused": "Codsigaaga #{id} ({subject}) si kumeelgaadh ah ayaa loo hakiyay; waanu kula soo xidhiidhi doonnaa.",
					"Resolved": "Codsigaagii #{id} ({subject}) waa la xalliyay. Waad ku mahadsan tahay samirkaaga.",
					"Closed": "Codsigaagii #{id} ({subject}) waa la xidhay. Haddii aad caawimo dheeri ah u baahato, fadlan nala soo xidhiidh.",
					"Cancelled": "Codsigaagii #{id} ({subject}) waa la joojiyay. Faahfaahin dheeri ah, fadlan nala soo xidhiidh.",
					"Reopened": "Codsigaagii #{id} ({subject}) dib ayaa loo furay, waana laga shaqaynayaa.",
				}
				# Unknown/custom statuses fall back to a generic Somali line naming the status.
				tpl = somali.get(str(doc.status)) or "Codsigaaga #{id} ({subject}): heerka cusub waa {status}."
				text = (tpl.replace("{id}", str(doc.name)).replace("{subject}", subject)
					.replace("{status}", str(doc.status)) + " — Yooltech Support")
				calls = [
					["send_customer_message", {"conversation_id": conv, "ticket": doc.name, "content": text,
						"phone": phone or doc.caller_phone}],
				]
				if category == "Resolved" or doc.status in ["Resolved", "Closed"]:
					calls.append(["set_conversation_label", {"conversation_id": conv, "ticket": doc.name,
						"add": [s.resolved_label or "ticket-resolved"]}])
				for c in calls:
					try:
						run_script("Chatwoot API", action=c[0], payload=c[1], internal_key=ikey)
					except Exception as e:
						frappe.log_error("Chatwoot sync: " + c[0] + " for ticket " + str(doc.name), str(e))
except Exception as e:
	frappe.log_error("Chatwoot sync: ticket " + str(doc.name), str(e)[:1000])

name: HD Ticket Sales Alert
script:
# Server Script — "HD Ticket Sales Alert"
# Script Type: DocType Event | Reference Doctype: HD Ticket | Event: After Insert
#
# A NEW ticket with source_team = "Sales" sends ONE WhatsApp brief to the Technical team number, through the
# Chatwoot door (action send_agent_message = ensure_conversation for the number + one outgoing message; the
# conversation is left resolved). The door applies the WhatsApp pause (Kanban switch), Chatwoot Settings
# "Notify agents on assignment" (the staff-message toggle), the rate limit, and writes Chatwoot Sync Log rows.
# Assignee shown: the Kanban new-ticket form passes its "Assign to" pick as form_dict.yool_assign_to (it assigns
# right after the insert); otherwise any assignment already present. Never blocks creating the ticket.

# Team WhatsApp numbers are NOT stored in code. Managers set them in the Kanban (⚙ Team numbers / Numbarrada
# kooxaha) or in Chatwoot Settings: sales_alert_tech_phone ("Numberka Kooxda Technical (WhatsApp)", receives the
# alert) and sales_alert_sales_phone ("Numberka Kooxda Sales", shown in the text). Both are normalized on save by
# Server Script "Chatwoot Settings Team Numbers". Empty Technical number = no alert + one Skipped Sync Log row.
TECH_PHONE = ""
SALES_PHONE = ""


def nz(v, empty):
	v = " ".join(str(v or "").split())
	return v if v else empty


if doc.source_team == "Sales":
	try:
		s = frappe.get_cached_doc("Chatwoot Settings")
		TECH_PHONE = str(s.get("sales_alert_tech_phone") or "").strip()
		SALES_PHONE = str(s.get("sales_alert_sales_phone") or "").strip()
		cust = doc.erp_customer or doc.customer
		company = frappe.db.get_value("Customer", cust, "customer_name") if cust else None
		assignee = None
		pick = str(frappe.form_dict.get("yool_assign_to") or "").strip()
		if pick:
			assignee = frappe.db.get_value("HD Agent", {"name": pick, "is_active": 1}, "agent_name")
		if not assignee:
			users = []
			try:
				users = json.loads(doc.get("_assign") or "[]") or []
			except Exception:
				users = []
			if not users:
				users = frappe.get_all("ToDo", filters={"reference_type": "HD Ticket", "reference_name": doc.name, "status": "Open"}, pluck="allocated_to")
			names = []
			for u in users:
				names.append(frappe.db.get_value("HD Agent", u, "agent_name") or frappe.get_fullname(u))
			assignee = ", ".join(names)
		details = ""
		try:
			details = frappe.utils.strip_html(doc.description or "")
		except Exception:
			details = str(doc.description or "")
		details = " ".join(details.replace(" ", " ").split())
		if len(details) > 200:
			details = details[:197] + "..."
		link = (s.helpdesk_url or "https://portal.yool.tech").rstrip("/") + "/helpdesk/tickets/" + str(doc.name)
		lines = [
			"📥 Shaqo cusub oo ka timid Kooxda Sales",
			"Ticket #" + str(doc.name) + " — " + nz(doc.subject, "(cinwaan la’aan)"),
			"",
			"🏢 Shirkadda: " + nz(company, "—"),
			"👤 Macmiilka: " + nz(doc.caller_name, "—") + " · " + nz(doc.caller_phone, "—"),
			"⚡ Mudnaanta: " + nz(doc.priority, "—"),
			"👷 Loo xilsaaray: " + nz(assignee, "Weli lama xilsaarin"),
			"📝 Faahfaahin: " + nz(details, "—"),
			"",
			"Waxaa soo gudbiyay: " + nz(frappe.get_fullname(doc.owner), doc.owner) + " (Kooxda Sales" + (" · " + SALES_PHONE if SALES_PHONE else "") + ")",
			"Fadlan qabso shaqadan; wixii su’aal ah kala xiriir Kooxda Sales.",
			"🔗 " + link,
			"— Yooltech Helpdesk",
		]
		if TECH_PHONE:
			run_script("Chatwoot API", action="send_agent_message", internal_key=s.get_password("internal_key", raise_exception=False),
				payload={"phone": TECH_PHONE, "name": "Kooxda Technical (Yooltech)", "ticket": doc.name, "content": "\n".join(lines)})
		else:
			frappe.get_doc({"doctype": "Chatwoot Sync Log", "direction": "Outbound", "event": "send_agent_message",
				"status": "Skipped", "reference_ticket": doc.name,
				"error": "Sales alert not sent: Technical team number is empty (Kanban ⚙ Team numbers / Chatwoot Settings)"}).insert(ignore_permissions=True)
	except Exception as e:
		frappe.log_error("Sales alert: ticket " + str(doc.name), str(e)[:1000])

name: HD Ticket Source Team
script:
# Server Script — "HD Ticket Source Team"
# Script Type: DocType Event | Reference Doctype: HD Ticket | Event: Before Save
#
# HD Ticket.source_team (Custom Field, Select "\nSales\nTechnical", label "Ka yimid / Raised by team") says which
# team raised the work. NEW tickets only: when it is empty it defaults to the creator's HD Team
# (member of "Sales" -> Sales, else member of "Technical" -> Technical; portal customers / others stay empty).
# Teams are managed in Helpdesk -> Teams. Does not touch routing (agent_group) or assignment.
#
# Sales lane (2026-10-22): a NEW ticket with source_team = Sales that would start in the default new status
# (HD Settings / SLA "default ticket status", "New" = Kanban column CUSUB) starts in HD Ticket Status "Sales"
# (category Open, Kanban column SALES) instead. The Technical team picks it up from there by moving it to
# Assigned / In Progress. "HD Ticket Chatwoot Sync" sends no customer message for a change INTO Sales.
# Helpdesk's on_communication_update resets the status to the default new status on every "Received"
# Communication (also the ticket's own first description right after the insert, and later customer replies).
# A ticket still in the Sales lane stays there in that case (status change + last_customer_response change in the
# same save); a person moving it out (drag / status menu) is never blocked.

if doc.is_new() and not doc.source_team:
	creator = doc.owner or frappe.session.user
	for team in ["Sales", "Technical"]:
		if not doc.source_team and frappe.get_all("HD Team Member", filters={"parenttype": "HD Team", "parent": team, "user": creator}, pluck="name"):
			doc.source_team = team

if doc.is_new() and doc.source_team == "Sales" and frappe.db.exists("HD Ticket Status", {"name": "Sales", "enabled": 1}):
	default_new = None
	if doc.sla:

# Server Script: "HD Ticket Type Required"
# Script Type: DocType Event | Reference DocType: HD Ticket | Event: Before Save
# Created 2026-10-18 on my.yool.tech. Enabled.
#
# Require a real ticket type before a ticket is resolved/closed.
# Fires only when status CHANGES to a Resolved-category status on an existing
# ticket, so Chatwoot/portal/agent ticket creation is never blocked.
# "Cancelled" is excluded on purpose (it is Resolved-category on this site,
# but junk/cancelled tickets should not demand a type) — remove that clause
# if cancelled tickets must also carry a type.
# --- Multiple ticket types (added 2026-10-19) ---------------------------------------------
# Custom Field HD Ticket.ticket_types (Table MultiSelect -> child doctype "HD Ticket Type Item",
# Link ticket_type) holds every type an agent picked; the FIRST row is the primary type and is
# always mirrored into the standard Link field ticket_type, which reports, totals, SLA and the
# guard below keep using (extra types are shown, never counted separately).
# This block runs BEFORE the guard, so the guard sees the synced primary.
#   - ticket_types changed (or ticket_type did not): ticket_type = first row.
#   - only ticket_type changed (old tickets, Helpdesk sidebar, other APIs): it becomes the first
#     row, replacing the previous primary; extra rows are kept.
#   - empty / "Unspecified" primary with no rows: the table stays empty.
# Rows are de-duplicated and "Unspecified" is never stored as a row.
def clean_types(values):
    out = []
    for v in values:
        if v and v != "Unspecified" and v not in out:
            out.append(v)
    return out

raw_rows = [r.ticket_type for r in (doc.get("ticket_types") or [])]
rows_now = clean_types(raw_rows)
prev = None if doc.is_new() else doc.get_doc_before_save()
prev_type = (prev.ticket_type if prev else "") or ""
prev_rows = clean_types([r.ticket_type for r in (prev.get("ticket_types") or [])]) if prev else []
cur_type = doc.ticket_type or ""
type_changed = cur_type != prev_type
rows_changed = rows_now != prev_rows
if rows_now and (rows_changed or not type_changed):
    if cur_type != rows_now[0]:
        doc.ticket_type = rows_now[0]
    new_rows = rows_now
elif cur_type and cur_type != "Unspecified":
    new_rows = clean_types([cur_type] + [x for x in rows_now if x != prev_type])
else:
    new_rows = []
if new_rows != raw_rows:
    doc.set("ticket_types", [{"ticket_type": x} for x in new_rows])

# --- Type required before closing (original guard) -------------------------------------
if not doc.is_new():

# Server Script — "ToDo Chatwoot Agent Notify"
# Script Type: DocType Event | Reference Doctype: ToDo | Event: After Insert
#
# When an HD Ticket is assigned to an agent (Helpdesk creates a ToDo), that agent gets one WhatsApp message with the
# full ticket brief, sent through the Chatwoot door (action send_agent_message). The text is Chatwoot Settings

# Switch: Chatwoot Settings "Notify agents on assignment" (staff only, separate from the customer test mode).
# Never blocks the assignment.


def nz(v):
	v = str(v or "").strip()
	return v if v else "—"


def when(dt):
	if not dt:
		return "—"
	# "2026-10-18 10:44:00" -> "18-10-2026 10:44" (strftime is not available here)
	v = str(dt)
	if len(v) >= 16 and v[4] == "-":
		return v[8:10] + "-" + v[5:7] + "-" + v[0:4] + " " + v[11:16]
	return v[:16]

				"Employee", {"user_id": user, "status": "Active"}, "cell_number") or frappe.db.get_value("User", user, "phone")
			agent_name = frappe.db.get_value("HD Agent", user, "agent_name") or frappe.get_fullname(user)
			company = frappe.db.get_value("Customer", t.erp_customer or t.customer, "customer_name") if (t.erp_customer or t.customer) else None
			details = ""
			try:
				details = frappe.utils.strip_html(t.description or "")
			except Exception:
				details = str(t.description or "")
			details = " ".join(details.split())
			if len(details) > 300:
				details = details[:297] + "..."
			# Status as the Kanban column name agents see (HD Kanban Settings label), else the status itself.
			shown = t.status
			try:
				cols = (json.loads(frappe.db.get_single_value("HD Kanban Settings", "config") or "{}") or {}).get("columns") or {}
				shown = (cols.get(t.status) or {}).get("label") or t.status
			except Exception:
				shown = t.status
			link = (s.helpdesk_url or "https://portal.yool.tech").rstrip("/") + "/helpdesk/tickets/" + str(t.name)
			values = {
				"{agent}": nz(agent_name.split(" ")[0] if agent_name else ""),
				"{id}": str(t.name),
				"{subject}": nz(t.subject),
				"{company}": nz(company),
				"{caller}": nz(t.caller_name),
				"{caller_phone}": nz(t.caller_phone),
				"{priority}": nz(t.priority),
				"{status}": nz(shown),
				"{team}": nz(t.agent_group),
				"{type}": nz(t.ticket_type),
				"{first_response_by}": when(t.response_by),
				"{resolution_by}": when(t.resolution_by),
				"{details}": nz(details),
				"{link}": link,
				"{assigned_by}": nz(frappe.get_fullname(doc.assigned_by or frappe.session.user)),
			}
			text = s.agent_message_template
			for k in values:
				text = text.replace(k, values[k])
			run_script("Chatwoot API", action="send_agent_message", internal_key=s.get_password("internal_key", raise_exception=False),
				payload={"phone": phone, "name": agent_name, "ticket": t.name, "content": text})
	except Exception as e:
		frappe.log_error("Chatwoot agent notify: ToDo " + str(doc.name), str(e)[:500])

script:
# Server Script "Yool Ticket Preview" — Script Type: API, API Method: yool_ticket_preview (GET, logged-in users).
# Runs inside Frappe safe_exec. Feeds the Ticket board's Preview panel with only what the panel shows:
# ticket summary, SLA, details, the last 3 messages (trimmed text, no attachments) and the last 5 activity entries.
#
# ?ticket=<name>            -> full panel payload
# ?ticket=<name>&check=1    -> {"modified": ...} only (cheap poll for changes made by others)
#
# Permissions: helpdesk agents only; the ticket is read through frappe.get_list, which applies the user's
# HD Ticket permissions, so a ticket the user may not read is reported as not found.

ticket = frappe.form_dict.get("ticket")
if not ticket:
    frappe.throw("Ticket is required.")

user = frappe.session.user
if user != "Administrator" and not frappe.db.exists("HD Agent", {"name": user, "is_active": 1}):
    frappe.throw("Only helpdesk agents can preview tickets.")

rows = frappe.get_list(
    "HD Ticket",
    filters={"name": ticket},
    fields=[
        "name", "subject", "status", "status_category", "priority", "ticket_type", "agent_group",
        "customer", "erp_customer_name", "contact", "raised_by", "primary_contact_name", "caller_name",
        "caller_phone", "via_customer_portal", "email_account", "opening_date", "opening_time", "creation",
        "modified", "_assign as assign_json", "sla", "agreement_status", "response_by", "first_responded_on",
        "resolution_by", "resolution_date", "on_hold_since", "source_team",
    ],
    limit_page_length=1,
)
if not rows:
    frappe.throw("Ticket " + str(ticket) + " was not found, or you do not have access to it.")
t = rows[0]

if frappe.form_dict.get("check"):
    frappe.response["message"] = {"name": t.name, "modified": str(t.modified)}
else:
    try:
        assigned = json.loads(t.assign_json or "[]") or []  # safe_exec blocks "_" attributes, hence the alias
    except Exception:
        assigned = []

    # Names and pictures for everyone shown in the panel, in one query.
    people = {}
    emails = list(assigned)
    messages = frappe.get_all(
        "Communication",
        filters={"reference_doctype": "HD Ticket", "reference_name": t.name, "communication_type": "Communication"},
        fields=["name", "sender", "sender_full_name", "creation", "content", "sent_or_received"],
        order_by="creation desc",
        limit_page_length=3,
    )
    comments = frappe.get_all(
        "HD Ticket Comment",
        filters={"reference_ticket": t.name},
        fields=["name", "commented_by", "owner", "creation", "content"],
        order_by="creation desc",
        limit_page_length=3,
    )
    activity = frappe.get_all(
        "HD Ticket Activity",
        filters={"ticket": t.name},
        fields=["action", "owner", "creation"],
        order_by="creation desc",
        limit_page_length=5,
    )
    for m in messages:
        emails.append(m.sender)
    for c in comments:
        emails.append(c.commented_by or c.owner)
    for a in activity:
        emails.append(a.owner)
    emails = [e for e in set(emails) if e]
    if emails:
        for u in frappe.get_all("User", filters={"name": ["in", emails]}, fields=["name", "full_name", "user_image"]):
            people[u.name] = {"name": u.full_name or u.name, "image": u.user_image}

    conversation = []
    for m in messages:
        who = people.get(m.sender) or {}
        conversation.append({
            "kind": "message",
            "sender": m.sender,
            "sender_name": m.sender_full_name or who.get("name") or m.sender,
            "image": who.get("image"),
            "incoming": m.sent_or_received == "Received",
            "at": str(m.creation),
            "text": (frappe.utils.strip_html(m.content or "") or "").strip()[:400],
        })
    for c in comments:
        # Comments added through the API may leave commented_by empty; the author is then the owner.
        author = c.commented_by or c.owner
        who = people.get(author) or {}
        conversation.append({
            "kind": "comment",
            "sender": author,
            "sender_name": who.get("name") or author,
            "image": who.get("image"),
            "incoming": False,
            "at": str(c.creation),
            "text": (frappe.utils.strip_html(c.content or "") or "").strip()[:400],
        })
    conversation = sorted(conversation, key=lambda x: x["at"], reverse=True)[:3]

    if t.via_customer_portal:
        channel = "Customer portal"
    elif t.email_account:
        channel = "Email"
    else:
        channel = "Created by agent"

    # All ticket types (Table MultiSelect ticket_types, first = primary); old tickets: just ticket_type.
    ticket_types = [r.ticket_type for r in frappe.get_all(
        "HD Ticket Type Item",
        filters={"parent": t.name, "parenttype": "HD Ticket", "parentfield": "ticket_types"},
        fields=["ticket_type"],
        order_by="idx asc",
    ) if r.ticket_type]
    if t.ticket_type and t.ticket_type != "Unspecified" and (not ticket_types or ticket_types[0] != t.ticket_type):
        ticket_types = [t.ticket_type] + [x for x in ticket_types if x != t.ticket_type]

    customer_name = t.erp_customer_name
    if t.customer and not customer_name:
        customer_name = frappe.db.get_value("Customer", t.customer, "customer_name")

    # frappe.has_permission is not exposed to server scripts: check the role permissions directly
    # (Custom DocPerm replaces the standard DocPerm when present). The save itself is still checked by Frappe.
    can_write = user == "Administrator"
    if not can_write:
        roles = [r[0] for r in frappe.db.sql(
            "SELECT role FROM `tabHas Role` WHERE parenttype = 'User' AND parent = %(user)s", {"user": user}
        )]
        perm_table = "tabCustom DocPerm" if frappe.db.sql(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabCustom DocPerm` WHERE parent = 'HD Ticket'"
        )[0][0] else "tabDocPerm"
        can_write = bool(roles) and bool(frappe.db.sql(
            "SELECT 1 FROM `" + perm_table + "` WHERE parent = 'HD Ticket' AND permlevel = 0 AND `write` = 1"
            " AND role IN %(roles)s LIMIT 1",
            {"roles": tuple(roles)},
        ))

    frappe.response["message"] = {
        "name": t.name,
        "subject": t.subject,
        "status": t.status,
        "status_category": t.status_category,
        "priority": t.priority,
        "ticket_type": t.ticket_type,
        "ticket_types": ticket_types,
        "team": t.agent_group,
        "source_team": t.source_team,
        "channel": channel,
        "customer": t.customer,
        "customer_name": customer_name,
        "contact": t.contact or t.raised_by,
        "primary_contact": t.primary_contact_name,
        "caller_name": t.caller_name,
        "caller_phone": t.caller_phone,
        "opened": str(t.opening_date) + " " + str(t.opening_time or "00:00:00") if t.opening_date else str(t.creation),
        "modified": str(t.modified),
        "assigned": [{"user": u, "name": (people.get(u) or {}).get("name") or u, "image": (people.get(u) or {}).get("image")} for u in assigned],
        "sla": {
            "name": t.sla,
            "status": t.agreement_status,
            "response_by": str(t.response_by) if t.response_by else None,
            "first_responded_on": str(t.first_responded_on) if t.first_responded_on else None,
            "resolution_by": str(t.resolution_by) if t.resolution_by else None,
            "resolution_date": str(t.resolution_date) if t.resolution_date else None,
            "on_hold_since": str(t.on_hold_since) if t.on_hold_since else None,
        },
        "conversation": conversation,
        "activity": [
            {"action": a.action, "by": (people.get(a.owner) or {}).get("name") or a.owner, "at": str(a.creation)}
            for a in activity
        ],
        "can_write": bool(can_write),
    }
